name: K-HALU
description: K-HALU is a Korean benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' hallucination detection capabilities in Korean. It covers seven domains with knowledge documents from Korean news, magazines, and books, and includes 40% multiple-answer questions requiring models to select all correct answers.
reputation: A newer Korean hallucination-detection benchmark that is useful for Korean-language LLM evaluation but has limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on hallucination detection in Korean knowledge; 40% multiple-answer questions for stricter evaluation.
